threads.body: This auth-detection condition misses valid boto3 credential sources, including `AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE` and ECS container credentials. When either is configured without the four checked clues, the fixture inserts `test_key`/`test_secret`; environment credentials take precedence over those providers, so live re-recording uses invalid credentials despite a valid AWS setup. Please restrict dummy credentials to offline playback, or preserve the SDK credential chain when recording.

threads.body: These additions leave dummy AWS credentials in the process environment after the test finishes. Because the fixture is autouse, subsequent tests—including tests from other packages collected in the same process—inherit them and resolve boto3 credentials differently. Please scope these writes with `monkeypatch.setenv` so teardown restores the environment, following [instrumentation/AGENTS.md:334](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python-genai/blob/main/instrumentation/AGENTS.md#tests).
